newsitem.title: CHINA: Daikin in $30mln China compressor venture.
newsitem.headline: Daikin in $30mln China compressor venture.

text.p: Japan's Daikin Industries Ltd has launched a $29.95 million joint venture with China's Qing'an Group to produce air-conditioner compressors in western China's Xi'an city, the Xinhua news agency said on Sunday.

The joint venture, called Xi'an Daikin Qing'an Compressor Co, would have an annual production capacity of 150,000 vortex compressors by the end of the project's first phase in October 1997, Xinhua said but gave no other details.
Daikin Industries Ltd, a major air-conditioner manufacturer, set up a joint venture in November 1995 with a sewing machine maker in Shanghai.
Qing'an Group, a state-owned air-conditioner maker, had an annual production capacity of one million units, Xinhua said.
